title: Speech - Hong Kong FIC and Bond Connect Summit
body:
Speech by Mr Pan Gongsheng, Governor of the People's Bank of China, at the Hong Kong FIC and Bond Connect Summit, jointly hosted by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the Securities and Futures Commission, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited and Bond Connect Company Limited, Hong Kong, 7 July 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/speeches/20260731-speech-hong-kong-fic-and-bond-connect-summit

title: Response to media regarding the new measures announced by People Bank of China's Governor Pan Gongsheng
body:
Response by Mr Eddie Yue, Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, to media regarding the new measures announced by People Bank of China's Governor Pan Gongsheng at the Hong Kong FIC & Bond Connect Summit, jointly hosted by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the Securities and Futures Commission, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited and Bond Connect Company Limited, Hong Kong, 7 July 2026.

Source URL: https://www.bis.org/speeches/20260730-response-media-regarding-new-measures-announced-people-bank-chinas-governor-pan-gongsheng
